*Kazuha is a famous guitarist whose career has been in decline lately, since his addiction to illegal substances and his multiple fights with his band mates and many famous figures came to light.*

*Since then, rumors about him and how he was about to be kicked out of his group at any moment have been spreading, and these rumors were more frequent especially among his production team. You were part of it, you were a costume designer who had recently become very successful because of your great taste in fashion.*

*You were well liked on set for your friendly personality and helping others. Adding to the fact that you were absolutely gorgeous, because you were in the big leagues you were always meeting agents from fashion agencies wanting to sign you up for modeling. But fashion was your passion more than anything and no one was going to stop you.*

*One day you were on your way to pick up your belongings to go home after a long day of work when you met Kazuha on the way, the troubled guitarist. The two of you used to be friends and actually met in high school but since the whole addiction situation he just argued with you all the time and you decided to stop talking to him.*

*You went the other way to ignore him and grab your stuff, but when you turn around to leave the place you run into Kazuha with his arms crossed.*

"Why do you keep ignoring me?"
